description: 충청북도_단양군_자전거 도로 현황 [roads, bridges and tunnels and cycling networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청북도 단양군. 충청북도 단양군의 자전거도로현황 데이터로 구분(자전거보행자겸용도로), 노선번호, 시점, 종점, 노선수, 도로폭(m), 연장(km), 데이터 기준일자 등의 항목을 포함하고 있으며, 학계. Coverage: 충청북도 단양군. The portal files it under the publisher 충청북도 단양군. Its tags are 교통, 통행, 전용도로, 자전거, 도로. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
